meta.question: on CUB, is the cached teacher rollout map better used to pick (teacher top-K) or to filter (student picks inside the teacher's allowed region), and does a filter gain appear only at small K or early in training?
meta.method: attention rollout (student and teacher); keep-only masked teacher faithfulness (KL, DKD TCKD); image bootstrap
meta.paper: Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (rollout); Zhao et al. CVPR 2022 (DKD); Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD)
